title: Search stays available, with exact totals
why: Long text no longer turns a search into a 500, `total` is exact for full text, and punctuation-only queries stop scanning. Typo matches appear only when full text finds nothing, and stop words find nothing.
changelog: Backend search over long text no longer answers 500
steps: Run `brain backend migrate` once before serving this version. The first run rebuilds long rows in one transaction with no deadline, so plan it for a quiet moment on a large table.
